intro: No hot water after a long day? In Canggu that can mean a failed heating element, a corroded thermostat, or a solar collector losing efficiency under months of salt air and heavy rain. I handle Water Heater Repair & Installation Canggu for electric tanks, gas units and rooftop solar systems across villas, co-living spaces and rentals.

sections.h3: Why Canggu's Fast Build-Out Stresses Your Heater
sections.text: Canggu went from rice paddies to a dense cluster of villas and co-living buildings in just a few years. That speed left a trail: fittings torqued down by hand, drain lines sloped the wrong way, electrical connections sitting close to ground moisture that seeps up from old paddy soil. In Berawa especially, I see heaters corrode at the base within two or three seasons because nobody checked the anode rod after the first monsoon. The high water table keeps everything damp, and damp kills heating elements.

sections.h3: The Jobs I See Most Around Echo Beach
sections.text: Around Echo Beach the call-outs follow a pattern. One villa's electric heater trips the main breaker every time it kicks on — usually a shorted element or a cracked thermostat housing. Another unit weeps from the flange gasket and leaves a rust ring on the tile below. Rooftop solar systems that once delivered proper heat now only manage lukewarm water because the collector plate has scaled over. And then there are the new builds where no one ever installed a heater properly, so I'm sizing and mounting one from scratch.

sections.h3: What to Send Before I Head Over
sections.text: Before I pack my van, send a few photos through WhatsApp: the front of the unit with the model plate visible, a close-up of any leak or scorch mark, and a short video if the breaker is tripping or the water is barely warm. Tell me whether it's an electric tank, a gas cylinder setup, or a rooftop solar array, and roughly how old it is. That's enough for me to bring the right parts and give you a fair quote before I start turning wrenches.

sections.h3: Keeping Your Heater Alive Through Rainy Season
sections.text: In Babakan the rainy season turns gardens into small rivers, and pump rooms fill faster than most owners expect. Before October hits, check your heater's anode rod — if it's crumbled, swap it out while you're up on the roof anyway. Make sure the overflow pipe from your pool isn't pointing at the electrical panel, and confirm the pump-room drain still clears after a hard downpour. A ten-minute walk around these points each dry-season month saves a lot of mid-monsoon headaches.

faq.q: How much does water heater repair cost in Canggu?
faq.a: It depends entirely on what's wrong and which part needs replacing. Send photos of the unit and the fault on WhatsApp and I'll come back with a clear quote before any work starts.

faq.q: Can you install a new heater where there was none before?
faq.a: Yes — I size the tank or solar array to your household's hot-water demand, run the plumbing and wiring, and connect it to your existing supply. Just send a photo of the space and current setup on WhatsApp so I can plan the layout.

faq.q: My rooftop solar heater only gives lukewarm water now. Is it fixable?
faq.a: Often yes. Scaled collector plates, a stuck diverter valve, or a degraded heat-exchange coil are common culprits. If the panel itself is cracked beyond repair, I'll fit a replacement and wire it into your current system.
